description: This file defines the Event model class, including methods for retrieving, saving, validating, and firing events within the Goteo application. It includes properties related to event identity, type, status, and callbacks, as well as exception handling for duplicate and not found cases.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents an event within the Goteo system, providing mechanisms for creating, retrieving, validating, saving, and executing associated callbacks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Event with specified action and type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance from the database by action.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance from the database by ID.

methods.name: getByHash
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance from the database by hash.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Retrieves an event instance from the database by a specified field and value.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an event with the given hash exists, optionally only considering succeeded events.

methods.name: encodeAction
methods.description: Encodes an action array or string into a standardized string format.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the event's action and hash, throws exception if a duplicate succeeded event exists.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the event instance to the database, with error handling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the event, mainly checking for duplication.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callable PHP callback for the event, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Executes the callback associated with the event, saves the result, handles exceptions.
